answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks using collateralized staking deposits. When freight agents clear shipments like yarrow at an autonomous wharf, each entity must lock escrow tokens that are slashed if malicious behavior is detected. An attacker attempting to forge multiple identities incurs the scarce cost of locking discrete liquid capital per entity. However, this approach inherently favors wealthy adversaries and excludes underfunded open-source agents.
